title: Hearty Flaky Kenyan Haddock Pie
description: A cozy Kenyan dish featuring haddock in a flaky crust, with an umami flavor profile and ayurvedic-tamasic friendly ingredients, this pie is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, curry powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out into a large circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, and haddock fillets.
Place the haddock mixture in the center of the dough circle, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the top with the remaining egg.
Bake the pie for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is cooked through.
